theorems.name: Submission.rsod_tv_exists_structure
theorems.statement: ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ) (U : Set (Amb n ℓ)) (V : RectifiableVarifold n ℓ U) (x₀ : Amb n ℓ), ∃ W : RectifiableVarifold n ℓ ((fun y => y + x₀) ⁻¹' U), W.carrier = (fun y => y + x₀) ⁻¹' V.carrier ∧ ∀ y, W.mult y = V.mult (y + x₀)
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
